description: Provenance of each group of reported results: what kind of quantity it is, where it comes from, which script recomputes it and which protocol governs it. Predictions in data/ are the recorded outputs of the identifiers listed in data/model_identities.json; analysis/predict.py reruns any identifier on any unit set and reports agreement with the recorded predictions.

records.results: Panel 1 and Panel 2 retention, destinations and paired release contrasts; Hindi-bucket composition on the six-row mixture; script closure; confidence survival
records.uncertainty: Conditional source-resampling intervals; not estimates for a web population

records.uncertainty: No sampling interval for the census; conditional resampling for the selected references

records.results: Angika released split read by langid.py, CLD3 and lid.176, and five-identifier agreement
records.uncertainty: Per-document predictions were not kept; the shares survive as recorded aggregates. A later run of the same identifiers on the rebuilt documents gives 0.9995 (lid.176) and 0.9983 (CLD3), matching the recorded values, and 0.9993 (langid.py, py3langid 0.4.0) against the recorded 0.9956.
